# Unciv Wiki

> Bilingual community guide to Unciv and the Unciv4iOS port. Content baseline: 4.21.20 (1293), Civ V - Gods & Kings. Not an official Civilization product or a live latest-version feed.

## Start here
- [Your first game](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/getting-started/)
- [Detailed match guides](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/strategies/): twelve guides covering general play, four victory routes, religion, Babylon, Korea, Rome and Greece.
- [Science victory](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/strategies/science-victory/): Apollo and six spaceship parts assembled in the capital.
- [Culture victory](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/strategies/culture-victory/): five completed policy branches and Utopia.
- [Database overview](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/database/): base values, not final prices in every game.
- [Practical mechanics and costs](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/mechanics/): policies, citizens/resources, combat/promotions, religion/beliefs; original cost reference retained.
- [V3 achievements](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/achievements/): 40 local achievements, 600 points. No Game Center or iCloud achievement sync.
- [Achievement troubleshooting](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/guides/achievement-troubleshooting/)
- [Unciv on iOS](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/ios/): real TestFlight invitation; build 1293 tester availability is not confirmed.
- [About and source boundaries](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/about/)

- [数据百科](https://jerry8870.github.io/Unciv-Wiki/zh/database/)

Generated data is pinned to checksummed source snapshots. Editorial advice is not a claim of full live iOS verification. This file helps readers discover content; it is not a search ranking or AI inclusion guarantee.
